::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Whitefield) fabless firm incorporated in June 2023 (directors Nitin and Parul Gupta). Lists two power ICs with full specs: a 4.5-28 V, 3 A synchronous buck converter (SIGBPCMV3X) and a 2.5-60 V linear LED driver (SIGLLNHVFX), aimed at automotive, industrial and consumer uses. Also offers analog, mixed-signal and digital IP and design services. No tape-out or customer publicly reported.
:::
